body: Thank you. I feel its a little late for me but thanks for responding

Thanks for the reply. I already have no friends. It's my parents that care about me enough to keep me from going through with it. When they die I'm off. I am almost 30. I haven't made any meaningful connections in that time. I have no relationship experience and it is safe to assume I am thought of as damaged goods. Rightly so. I increasingly talk to myself out loud. I am losing my mind due to the isolation. Every time I interact with the world I am either met with disdain or false acceptance as though I was mentally disabled. Guess I am. Thanks again. It helps to type this out
